description: 15-year-old Alexis Grigoropoulos was fatally shot by special guard Epaminondas Korkoneas in Exarcheia.
outcome: Korkoneas convicted of murder (life, 2010); reduced to 13yrs on appeal 2019, released 2022; life sentence without leniency re-imposed by Lamia Mixed Court of Appeal 4 June 2025.

description: Activist Zak Kostopoulos died after being beaten by a jewelry shop owner and a real estate agent, and subsequently by police officers during arrest.
outcome: Two civilians convicted (10yrs, upheld on appeal); four police officers acquitted May 2022 despite footage of force during arrest.

description: 18-year-old Roma youth Nikos Sampanis was fatally shot by police following a car chase in Perama.
outcome: Police officers charged with intentional homicide; pending trial.

description: 16-year-old Roma youth Kostas Fragkoulis was shot in the head by a police officer in Thessaloniki after reportedly fleeing a gas station without paying. He died days later.
outcome: Officer charged with manslaughter with possible intent.

description: The fishing trawler Adriana sank off the coast of Pylos, resulting in over 600 presumed deaths. Allegations surfaced regarding the Hellenic Coast Guard's involvement in a towing operation prior to the sinking.
Video surfaced showing police officers beating a man in Nea Smyrni square during COVID-19 restriction checks, sparking large-scale protests.
Use of firearms by police officers during a pursuit.
outcome: Violation of Article 2 (Right to life) found regarding the substantive and procedural aspects.

outcome: Noted persistent allegations of ill-treatment by police.
